The '''Distinguished Medal of Imperial Honor''' was a prestigious award of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the successor to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Medallion of Honor]]. Its recipients included [[Rom Mohc]], for his numerous achievements on the field of battle, and [[Sergus Lanox]].<ref name="TCoIH">{{JournalCite|10|The Capture of Imperial Hazard|The Capture of ''Imperial Hazard''}}</ref>
